name: v79_two_day_reversal_decay60
hypothesis: The raw 2-day close reversal is low-correlation but too high turnover; high decay may bring turnover below the 25% local gate while retaining enough Sharpe.
notes: Direct repair of O0pG9rG1/GrwGov5x; no fundamental/news/option anchors.

name: v79_five_day_mean_reversal
hypothesis: A 5-day mean return reversal may reduce turnover relative to raw daily returns while keeping the low-correlation contrarian profile.
notes: Tests medium-short horizon reversal without close/open or vwap.

name: v79_ten_day_rank_reversal_low_vol
hypothesis: Reversal works better after smoother selloffs; add low realized volatility to improve fitness and drawdown.
expression: 0.55 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns, 10)) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(historical_volatility_20, 60)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_60_days_spy, 90), industry)
notes: Low-vol risk control; strict corr gate vs LLpGdlrm/0m7p1Lb1/kq3Jjmrk.

name: v79_reversal_dryup_risk
hypothesis: Price reversal after low relative volume may capture liquidity exhaustion rather than high-turnover noise.
expression: 0.45 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: No vwap/close-location; volume only as dry-up filter.

name: v79_reversal_social_relief
hypothesis: Small social value and fading buzz may distinguish recoverable short-term selloffs from deteriorating names.
expression: 0.45 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Small v76-style social sleeve; reject if corr moves to JjpPv3N2.

name: v79_two_day_reversal_group_industry
hypothesis: Industry-relative 2-day reversal with high decay may reduce market-wide noise and turnover.
notes: Industry-relative raw 2-day reversal; compare against simple decay60 variant.
